## 3 · Error handler
Set as the **Error workflow** of workflows 1 and 2, so a failed run is never silent:
1. Signed POST `/n8n/failures` → shows on LendLoop **Admin** (idempotent per execution id)
2. Email to `ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL`, even if step 1 failed
